description:
Senior Laravel Developer

We're looking for a Senior Laravel Developer who's inventive, self-sufficient, and genuinely enjoys learning something new every day.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain applications with Laravel (PHP)
  • Design and build internal Laravel-based frameworks/reusable components, applying solid software design patterns
  • Design and integrate APIs (REST) with internal and external systems
  • Work with Git and GitLab CI/CD pipelines for version control and automated deployments
  • Containerize and deploy services using Docker
  • Write and maintain automated tests as an embedded part of the development process
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud infrastructure
  • Implement observability into applications (metrics, logs, traces)
  • Use Redis for caching/queues where relevant
  • Build software with the necessary security measures embedded by design, not bolted on
  • Collaborate with the team but take full ownership of your work end-to-end — and if there's no task assigned, find one and get it done

Must have

  • Senior-level experience with Laravel and modern PHP
  • Experience designing/building software frameworks and applying software design patterns
  • Strong API design and integration experience
  • Cloud infrastructure experience (any major provider)
  • Solid SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred); SQL tuning experience highly appreciated
  • Comfortable operating on Linux
  • Proficiency with Git, GitLab CI/CD, and Docker
  • Redis experience
  • Experience with federated authentication providers (e.g. OAuth2/OIDC, SAML)
  • Security-first mindset — building it into the software, not as an afterthought
  • Test automation experience
  • Inventive — you look for better ways to solve problems, not just the first one that works
  • Self-sufficient — you pick up a task, figure out what's needed, and run with it. No task assigned? You find one.
  • A genuine appetite for learning — new tools, new patterns, new challenges

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • React experience (big plus, not mandatory)
  • Software performance tuning
  • Observability experience, preferably with the Grafana stack (Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir, Loki, Tempo) and OpenTelemetry
  • SAP integration experience
  • Experience in the construction industry (big plus)
  • Familiarity with UML and BPMN
